name: badge
need: Show a count or a dot on a button, chip, tab or drawer item

--ds-badge-size.description: a count badge (`.ds-badge`): height and smallest width at md

--ds-badge-bg.default: `--ds-accent`, `--ds-on-accent` (tones: their container pair; a dot: `--ds-primary`, a tone's full colour; on a tinted host `--ds-primary`, `--ds-on-primary`)

--ds-badge-color.default: `--ds-accent`, `--ds-on-accent` (tones: their container pair; a dot: `--ds-primary`, a tone's full colour; on a tinted host `--ds-primary`, `--ds-on-primary`)
